name: Kinsta WordPress First Month
free_limit: First month free for eligible new customers on select managed WordPress plans; Single 20GB includes 1 WordPress install, 20 GB server bandwidth/month, 10 GB storage and 125 GB CDN bandwidth/month.
watch_out: A time-limited first-month promotional offer, NOT an ongoing free plan. Single 20GB is $0 for the first month then $35/month on monthly billing, excluding taxes. New-customer and plan eligibility, automatic renewal, payment method and cancellation terms must be checked before signup.
